name: Golden-Haired Finder
description: Traveler's finder, built on the game's spiky-haired character: bright yellow hair, a teal outfit with a brown tie, and a brown satchel.
author: Traveler
request: A yellow hair NPC who found a gold coin he has no use for and gives it to you. He is looking for a pink crystal (spawns further away); bring it to him and he thanks you and flies away.
